label: DriverHook
note: Returns the version 101.1 renderer table and initializes the driver error state.

label: enumerate_subdrivers
note: Enumerates DirectDraw subdrivers and invokes the engine callback.

label: enumerate_modes
note: Enumerates DirectDraw modes and filters callback records to 16-bit modes plus WindowMode.

label: enumerate_pixel_formats
note: Builds pixel-format records for callback enumeration from queried display bit depth and channel masks.

label: initialize_renderer
note: Calls D3DDrv initialization with context fields and fills requested client dimensions.

label: shutdown_renderer
note: Calls the renderer cleanup/reset helper and returns success.

label: initialize_texture_cache
note: Initializes renderer caches and resets the frame draw counter.

label: initialize_direct3d_device
note: Initializes DirectDraw/device/render state and the texture cache before setting the viewport.

label: texture_handle_create
note: Allocates a texture handle and selects one of three surface creation routes from request flags.

label: texture_handle_create_mips
note: Creates a cache-backed surface for each progressively halved mip level.

label: texture_handle_create_multilevel
note: Creates a cache-backed DirectDraw surface with a requested level count.

label: texture_handle_create_single
note: Creates a DirectDraw surface using the requested width and height.

label: texture_handle_destroy
note: Releases cache references and surface objects for each mip-level record.

label: texture_level_lock
note: Locks a selected DirectDraw mip surface and returns its pixel pointer.

label: texture_level_unlock
note: Unlocks a selected mip surface and updates its state flags.

label: texture_mip_dimensions
note: Computes mip dimensions by shifting base width and height and copies texture flags.

label: begin_scene
note: Resets frame counters clears buffers begins the D3D scene and sets initial render states.

label: end_scene
note: Ends the D3D scene and flushes pending presentation work.

label: draw_textured_polygon
note: Scales texture UVs against texture dimensions and prepares optional vertex alpha before submitting a textured polygon.

label: draw_textured_vertices
note: Prepares and submits a textured vertex stream with raw per-draw flags.

label: blit_surface_rectangle
note: Clips rectangles to the render surface and calls DirectDraw Blt.

label: apply_fog_settings
note: Stores the fog tuple and forwards a constructed parameter block to the Direct3D object.
